Modal closes via modal-close. Quick-pick
critical_code_review_comments: ItemModal: pricePerKg uses toLocaleString('en-IN'); good. Modal eyebrow color is inline-styled per section accent — consistent.
Snacks.jsx: desktop <tr> uses cursor-pointer + onClick (good for click-to-modal) but is not keyboard-focusable. Consider role='button' tabIndex='0' onKeyDown for a11y. Mobile uses <button> (good).
ContactForm.jsx onPickItem: mutates e.target.value=''; works because <select> is uncontrolled with defaultValue=''. Acceptable but a controlled select w/ pickValue state would be cleaner.

Owner WhatsApp popup is opened post-await (after axios resolves). Some browsers may block as not a direct user gesture. Toast action button provides reliable manual fallback. Non-blocking — verified working in Chromium during test.
Backend Order model: created_at is required datetime; legacy entries without created_at would 500 on GET. Add Optional[datetime] for safety (carry-over from earlier iterations).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_* and one UITestUser2_<ts> order in Mongo `orders` via API during tests. Safe to clean up.

I would like to order: <name>.' Snack format: 'I would like to order: <qty> of <name>.'
